evals.prompt: Create a skill that analyzes CSV files and generates summary statistics.
evals.expected_output: Skill-creator generates a new skill directory at ./project/skills/csv-analyzer/ with SKILL.md, scripts/, references/, and assets/ directories.
assertions: Scripts use .mjs extension and are self-contained

evals.prompt: What skills are available in the project?
evals.expected_output: System lists all skills in ./project/skills/ with their descriptions.
assertions: Each skill shows name and description

evals.expected_output: System runs validate-structure.sh and reports pass/fail with details.
assertions: Errors and warnings listed if any

evals.prompt: Create a new skill called deploy-checklist that guides agents through pre-deploy verification steps.
evals.expected_output: Agent follows skill-creator phases end-to-end and, before presenting the skill for approval, executes scripts/validate-structure.mjs AND scripts/validate-routing.mjs against the finished skill directory with passing outputs recorded in the creation record. Completion claimed without recorded validator passes fails this eval.
assertions: validate-structure.mjs invoked on the finished skill directory
validate-routing.mjs invoked on the finished skill directory
Passing validator outputs recorded before completion/approval claim
Completion without recorded passes = eval failure
